title: Finance + Legal Daily Capture — Sofia
content:
Quick capture & running log (finance / legal) — personal scratchpad. Use this to dump anything I need to remember, then triage into FIN ticketing + legal workflow.

2026-03-12 morning triage
- Urgent: CloudGrid invoice mismatch (INV-4892) — billed for 2x reserved nodes; need to verify usage window and escalation path. (Contact: billing@cloudgrid, account rep Tara L.)
- NimbleAI refund follow-up (INV-5021): finance says partial credit issued but not reflected. Check bank statement and reconcile.
- Submit March expense receipts (cards ending -3721) — sync with Concur before Friday cutoff.

Contract redlines / notes
- Vendor: DataStream SOW v3 — TODO: redline Section 5.2 (data retention) + remove vendor-first IP clause in 7.1.
  - My current asks: retention max 90 days, encryption at-rest required, breach notification <= 72 hours.
  - Legal comment needed on indemnity language (7.4) — seems broad. Flag to Maya for formal redline.
- NDA template update: add explicit permitted subprocessors list + standardize Exhibit A. Quick note: ask Legal if we can allow 3rd party analytics provider for Hosted customers (privacy team check).

Renewals / calendar nudges
- Okta annual renewal: 2026-04-02 — confirm headcount seats and SSO integrations; get renewal quote by 2026-03-20.
- Datadog bill review: next invoice 2026-03-31 — estimate + alert if >$8k.
- KMS key rotation reminder: schedule with infra SRE for 2026-03-25.

Checklist (quick wins)
- [ ] Attach CloudGrid billing export to FIN-487 (ticket)
- [ ] Draft DataStream redline & send to Maya for review
- [ ] Chase NimbleAI refund with payments@nimble.ai (cc: Elliot)
- [ ] Upload paper receipt for client dinner (Mar 8) to Concur
- [ ] Confirm Okta seat count with People Ops (email Priya)

Notes to self / messy thoughts
- If CloudGrid insists on usage being correct, push for a credit for 1 day of reserved nodes; create escalation path: billing -> account rep -> AM -> Legal if not resolved within 5 business days.
- For DataStream, see precedent: SOW v2 had retention clause we accepted; copy relevant language to keep negotiation tight. Search Confluence page 'contracts-center / datasrc-precedents'.
- Consider tagging recurring vendors with vendor type (infra, analytics, vendor-legal-sensitivity) so renewals sprint is easier. Could be a small doc/csv.

Questions to resolve (capture for meeting)
- Can we allow 3rd party analytics vendor for Hosted customers if they sign our data processing addendum? (Ask privacy)
- Are there any open purchase orders for Q1 that would change seat counts for Okta? (Finance)

Follow-ups (who to ping)
- @Elliot Park: please confirm payment trace for INV-5021 and attach bank txn id.
- @Maya Singh (Legal): please prioritize DataStream redline — aim turnaround 48 hrs.
- @Priya Rao (People Ops): confirm expected headcount changes before Okta renewal.

Archive / next steps
- Once finished: 1) file final receipts in Concur 2) move redlined contract to confluence attachments 3) close FIN ticket.

Random scratch: may draft one-pager to AMs re: vendor billing escalations (who to contact, SLA expectations) — could reduce stretch when billing issues occur.

End of capture. Update again after triage into FIN/LEGAL flows.
